video_title: Is LeBron's FINAL CHAPTER with Steph Curry & the Warriors?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Warriors adding LeBron James and Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: This move doesn't make the Thunder worse. This move doesn't make the Spurs worse.
quotes.quote: This season tickets go up. The jersey sales are unbelievable. It's so much fun to see all those legends on the court at the same time, but this move doesn't make the Thunder worse. This move doesn't make the Spurs worse. The Nuggets, the Timberwolves, the Rockets, the Lakers, there's still so many teams that are so competitive in the Western Conference. I'd like to see it. It's fun. It'd be a hell of a way for LeBron James to go out with his boys. We know how close he is with Anthony Davis, we know how close he is with Draymond Green, we know how much he respects the Warriors organization and Stephen Curry.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams compares potential Warriors superteam to past legends
quotes.excerpt: It makes me think about Manny Pacquiao and Floyd Mayweather. It just feels like five years too late.
quotes.quote: It makes me think about Manny Pacquiao and Floyd Mayweather. It just feels like five years too late for it to have the sting that I wanted to have. As much as I want to love this, I don't know. History tells me when all the legends and the Hall of Fame guys link up at the end of the road, it never works out. I've seen this movie time and time again.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the pitfalls of aging stars teaming up
quotes.excerpt: I've seen Russell Westbrook, Carmelo Anthony, so on and so forth. All of our legends go link up.
quotes.quote: I've seen Russell Westbrook, Carmelo Anthony, so on and so forth. All of our legends go link up with the other legends at the end of their careers for a feel-good story and it just never ends well. I don't want this to be a damper on Stephen Curry. I don't want this to be a damper on LeBron James, Anthony Davis, or Draymond Green. I just feel like everybody go to your respective corners and let's finish this thing out smoothly instead of all linking up and leaving a bad taste in people's mouths after that experience.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle compares Def Leppard's longevity to the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Def Leppard was basically the biggest band in the 80s and 90s. I've seen them five times.
quotes.quote: Def Leppard was basically the biggest band in the 80s and 90s. The biggest touring band at the time. I've seen them five times in the 2020s. They're still crushing and they fill up stadiums and they sell out. This is how I am now looking at this team. This is going to be hell of entertaining.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams demands championship success from a potential superteam
quotes.excerpt: When you start talking about LeBron James and Stephen Curry and all of these guys, you have no choice.
quotes.quote: When you start talking about LeBron James and Stephen Curry and all of these guys, you have no choice but to talk championships and success. I don't want a feel-good story where they're going out getting their asses kicked but they're together. I don't want to see that. Either make some noise or just don't do it. That's how I feel about it.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons questions the health of aging superstars
quotes.excerpt: Stephen Curry has missed some time with some injuries this past season. LeBron James has missed some time.
quotes.quote: Stephen Curry has missed some time with some injuries this past season. LeBron James has missed some time. Anthony Davis has missed some time. What does this look like when they're all together? How much of this do we actually need?

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on billionaires working for happiness over money
quotes.excerpt: You know who gets to say I'm going to work for happiness and not money? Billionaires.
quotes.quote: You know who gets to say I'm going to work for happiness and not money? Billionaires. That's who gets to wake up in the morning and say I'm doing it for happiness. But I am happy that that's where he is right now and that's where we should all be.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on LeBron James' limited remaining career
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't have very many years left. We know that. And so, if you get an opportunity.
quotes.quote: He doesn't have very many years left. We know that. And so, if you get an opportunity to go play with these Hall of Famers and Stephen Curry and a team that you've admired from a distance, listen, I don't think it's the worst idea. I just, they're just not going to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the inevitable criticism of LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Any move that he makes, whether he stays with the Lakers, whether he goes somewhere, is going to be.
quotes.quote: Any move that he makes, whether he stays with the Lakers, whether he goes somewhere, is going to be chopped apart one way or another. So it's really, if it's really about happiness and for him, I think he's going to put himself in the best position possible to have his at least amount of stress as possible wherever he goes.
